job.title: [Post] STIBO STEP Technical Lead Greetings from Resource Corner ...

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & Integrations
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, and database performance tuning. Proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems, including Dynamics 365 integration experience. Hands-on with CI/CD, cloud deployments, and agile delivery.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: STIBO STEP Technical Lead
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Technical Lead role at Resource Corner IT. With over 5 years of specialized enterprise experience building and integrating large SAP Commerce (Hybris) platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise in complex system integrations and data workflows.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Integration
bullets.text: Designed and implemented robust backend integrations and OCC REST Web Services connecting SAP Commerce Cloud platforms with enterprise data ecosystems.

bullets.label: PIM and ERP Data Flows
bullets.text: Built and optimized complex PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub to ensure seamless multi-system data synchronization.

bullets.label: Technical Problem Solving
bullets.text: Investigated and resolved intricate integration bottlenecks between enterprise ERP, MDM, and e-commerce platforms in fast-paced international environments.

bullets.label: API and Architecture Design
bullets.text: Engineered scalable API migrations and custom data flows, improving system stability and data consistency across global channels.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit and am serving my notice period with a last working day on 15 December 2026 (earliest start 16 December 2026). I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my integration expertise aligns with your technical requirements.

tailoring.why_company: I want to bring my extensive enterprise SAP Commerce integration and backend engineering background to Resource Corner IT, helping drive complex technical implementations, robust system integrations, and high-performance e-commerce architectures for your clients.
tailoring.motivation_short: Leveraging 5+ years of enterprise SAP Commerce integration experience to drive scalable technical solutions and seamless data workflows.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of SAP Commerce (Hybris) backend and integration experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am very interested in the Technical Lead position at Resource Corner IT. Let's connect to discuss how I can add value to your team.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: STIBO STEP Technical Lead – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the STIBO STEP Technical Lead position. With over 5 years of professional experience engineering complex SAP Commerce integrations, APIs, and data pipelines at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise in enterprise e-commerce platforms. I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit, and my earliest available start date is 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing my application with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
